0x0008B5.en: 「At my current level...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x000926.en: 「Guh!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x0009AE.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000AD7.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000B0F.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000C13.en: 「Blowing it in a place like this...!@　What a drag...」

0x000C67.en: 「I messed up...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000D51.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000DB8.en: 「This is it for me... I leave the rest to you.」

0x000DEA.en: 「Damn it...!@　So this is the end!」

0x000E64.en: 「No good, we've taken too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000EB1.en: 「What a mess. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000EEF.en: 「Kyah! I'll leave the rest in your hands!」

0x000F36.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000FE1.en: 「Ngh... So I'm the one who becomes a shooting star... I'm ejecting!」

0x00118A.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0011D1.en: 「Sorry... the rest is up to you.」

0x001206.en: 「Damn! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x0012F2.en: 「To lose in a place like this...@ I'm still too green...!」

0x001340.en: 「No good, I can't go on! Retreating!」

0x0013FB.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x00142A.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001468.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x001497.en: 「I can't do any more. I'll take my leave.」

0x001522.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back here...!」

0x001688.en: 「Ejecting...@ Ngh...! Can't even do it gracefully...」

0x001746.en: 「Ngh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001916.en: 「A-all hands!@ Abandoning ship is top priority...!!」

0x00198A.en: 「Guess I've no choice but to retreat...!」

0x001A42.en: 「Their numbers and strength are growing.@ And neither of those two has lost their fighting spirit.」

0x001A98.en: 「I'm watching their movements now, and@ they seem to be heading for the site Contagio@ chose as a candidate for the Officinas.」

0x001B4A.en: 「What'll you do? Seize the site while we can?」

0x001B8A.en: 「No, I'll go myself.@ Together with Glacies and Ventos.@ There's something I want to confirm with my own eyes...」

0x001C21.en: 「Captain, the third defense line has been breached!」

0x001C5E.en: 「Damn them, too fast!@ What's the status on that procedure!?」

0x001CAE.en: 「Well... Dr. Wong seems to be dragging his feet.」

0x001CF1.en: 「What!? Argh, I'll talk to him directly!」

0x001D60.en: 「...I'd hate to ruin something@ I worked so hard to build.」

0x001DC2.en: 「We can't just hand it over to the enemy!」

0x001E0B.en: 「I could hand it over, though. It belongs to them by rights.@ Besides, they'll fight the Ruina too.」

0x001E91.en: 「You...!@ Enough, I'll have the Merton squad do the work!@ Interfere, and detention will be the least of it!」

0x001F2A.en: 「I don't think you've time to be snapping at me.」

0x001F77.en: 「Cease fire! All units, ahead of the ship!」

0x001FAE.en: 「So that's Pillbox 8.@ Feels different from where I was held.」

0x002010.en: 「Doctor Cliff, any guess on where the@ Weapon Box Hangar is stored?」

0x00208E.en: 「If it was built to the blueprints,@ it won't fit in the surface hangars visible from here.」

0x002160.en: 「Then we'll take Pillbox 8.@　If the Weapon Box Hangar's presence is@　confirmed, we secure it at the same time.」

0x00221A.en: 「Given what comes after,@ we can't afford to waste time here.@ All units, carry out your mission swiftly.」

0x0022B6.en: 「Joshua, Lim, you two find the underground entrance.」

0x0022FF.en: 「But the time limit is seven minutes.@ If we've no leads by then, things get rough later.@ Understood?」

0x002396.en: 「Even if we find the treasure,@ no telling if we can use it...@ This is one hell of a gamble.」

0x002429.en: 「If it turns out to be a wasted trip, I'm sorry.」

0x002463.en: 「If the Weapon Box Hangar's the real deal,@ it'll be an unbeatable card.@ It's worth the bet.」

0x00250B.en: 「This operation's also about gathering intel.@ Even if there's no NV Unit,@ it won't be a wasted trip.」

0x0025A1.en: 「It helps to hear you say that.」

0x0025D5.en: 「Joshua, Lim, I've checked the spots that look@ like underground entrances. Transmitting the data.」

0x00265B.en: 「Bro, shouldn't we just pick one@ to bet on?」

0x0026B7.en: (Ugh... relying on a hunch is too risky.)

0x0026E8.en: 「We can't afford another bad bet.@ Slow and steady - we check them one by one, starting nearby.」

0x002774.en: (I think that's the better way too.)

0x0027DD.en: 「All units, spread out!@ Don't let the enemy target Joshua and Lim!」

0x002837.en: 「Three minutes to the time limit!@ Find the underground entrance, quickly!」

0x00296D.en: 「You don't have to tell me, I know!」

0x0029EF.en: 「Enemy approaching, four o'clock, straight in!@ Entering range 3 shortly!@ ID: Gaia Sabers!」

0x002AB7.en: 「The nerve, striking at our base like this.」

0x002B1D.en: 「Heh, adding to their own disgrace.@ What fools.」

0x002BDF.en: (Aqua... you did just as I told you.)

0x002C19.en: 「Major Albero, Aqua told me about your talk with Hugo.@ What was your true intent in recruiting him?」

0x002CBC.en: 「Could it be you never truly wanted@ to fight Hugo at all?」

0x002D62.en: 「Major Albero,@ there must be a reason you can't reveal the truth!」

0x002DB8.en: 「As a Gaia Saver, I strike down traitors. @ That's all there is to it.」

0x002E17.en: 「Miss Mitte, are you the same way!?」

0x002E57.en: 「It's as I said last time.@ What about you - how do you feel?」

0x002EC3.en: 「I can't forgive you...!@ But if I can help it, I don't want to fight...」

0x002F37.en: 「Hey, what are you saying!@ That woman is the one who killed Hugo!」

0x002F93.en: 「I know that...@ But to learn the truth of the Zentral Project,@ we need her.」

0x003039.en: 「That woman kept deceiving the lieutenant!@ Show her mercy now and she won't feel a thing!」

0x0030BF.en: 「E-even so, she was someone I looked up to...@ Someone I respected...」

0x003118.en: 「Why did she become the way she is...@ I want to know that reason too...!」

0x003189.en: 「So, what do you intend to do?」

0x0031B7.en: 「Abandon the Medius and surrender.@ And then atone for taking Hugo's life...」

0x003241.en: 「Aqua... you truly are naive.@ Do you understand why I told you@ to pilot that machine?」

0x0032D1.en: 「To become the nourishment that grows this Medius.@ Until your very last moment.」

0x003361.en: 「You already understand, don't you, Aqua.@ That is her true nature.」

0x0033C0.en: 「Cut yourself off from it, or you'll die.@ Carry out the mission you were given.」

0x0034B6.en: 「That error tone just now - what was that?」

0x003518.en: 「...Gamma 1 to all units.@　Capturing the Re-Tech unit is top priority. Understood?」

0x00357D.en: （Idiot. Like anyone's gonna follow that order in a spot like this!）

0x0035C9.en: （I'm gonna paint the ground red with 'em!）

0x003606.en: 「This is Joshua! I've found the entrance to the underground! Moving in!」

0x0036C2.en: 「This is Lim! Found the entrance to the underground! Moving in!」

0x0037FB.en: 「You're telling me to reorder the operation's priorities?」

0x003838.en: 「Yes. There's something I want to confirm.」

0x00386F.en: （That's right... the reason for that rejection earlier...）

0x0038A6.en: 「I know that... But to learn the truth of@　the Zentr Project, I need the professor.」

0x003936.en: 「Aqua... you really are too soft.@　Do you understand why I told you@　to pilot that machine?」

0x0039C6.en: 「You already understand, don't you, Aqua.@　That is her true nature.」

0x003AA9.en: 「Tch, you'll pay for that! I'm pulling back!」

0x003AE6.en: 「Damn it, I'm off my game today! Retreating!」

0x003B95.en: 「He's having trouble breaching the bulkhead in the@　underground hangar. Something's definitely back there...」

0x003C25.en: 「We can't go carelessly blasting the bulkhead@　and risk damaging the@　weapon box hangar.」

0x003CB5.en: 「Captain, I'd suggest sending Fighter Roar in@　to open the doors from the inside.」

0x003D2C.en: 「Then send him to the underground hangar at once.」

0x003D78.en: 「Multiple high-heat sources closing in! Straight down@　from directly above the ship! Believed to be missiles!」

0x003E6A.en: 「Enemy missiles impacting!@　Mobile weapons descending after them! ID: Ruina!@　Three Melior Esse units confirmed!」

0x003F16.en: 「We sprang the ambush, and now we're the ones ambushed.」

0x003F53.en: 「Albero, AI1 isn't running right.@　We should pull back here.」

0x003FAF.en: 「You said there was no problem earlier.」

0x003FEC.en: 「To avoid a foreseeable risk. Let's withdraw.」

0x00407A.en: 「Joshua Radcliff...@　I know you're here.@　Come out.」

0x0040F8.en: 「Professor Mitte!@　What is the true purpose of@　the Zentr Project!?」

0x004173.en: 「As you already know - research into@　Terminus Energy and Rasmunanium,@　and the development of the TE Absorber.」

0x004268.en: 「I'll tell you one truth, Aqua.@　I will kill you here, with this Medius.@　Without hesitation.」

0x00432C.en: 「Argh! What the hell is that thing!?」

0x004379.en: 「Heh, like that junk's ever gonna hit me!@　Stand down if you don't wanna get hurt!」

0x00441B.en: 「If words won't get through to ya!@　Take this! Fighter Beam Gun!」

0x004483.en: 「D-damn it! No good! Fall back, fall back!!」

0x0044E8.en: 「...Ho ho ho, the hero has arrived.」

0x0045B6.en: 「Perfect timing.@　I'd like your help removing the bombs@　planted on the weapon box hangar.」

0x00466B.en: 「Now then, I'll open the bulkhead for you.@　Best call the knight and Snow White...」
